$comment: A static site cannot list a directory, so this file is how the index page finds
every card. It lists usernames, one per profile-data/<username>.json file.
Two ways to keep it current — either is fine:
1. Edit it here. Add your username to "profiles" below. This is the way to go
if you have no Node.js: it works in GitHub's web UI and needs no build.
Bump "count" to match, or leave it — the page uses the list, not the number.
2. Run `npm run build`, which regenerates this file from profile-data/.
Written by tools/build-links.js. If you run the build it overwrites hand edits,
which is what you want: the JSON files are the source of truth. Your cards work
either way — /c/<username>/ loads the profile by name and does not read this list.
